critical_code_review_comments: mockData.js pickPool() correctly handles both explicit chipset key ('SAMSUNG') AND accidental event-object passthrough — guards against onClick={startSearch} bugs. ✓

SamsungService.jsx `matches = device.platform === 'Samsung'` (line 26) — correctly aligned with generateDevice() which sets platform='Samsung'. Previous bug (device.brand === 'Samsung') would never match since brand strings are 'Samsung Galaxy S9' etc. Fix verified. ✓
ActionGrid platformOk gate (line 50): `!device || device.platform === platform || platform === 'ALL'`. For Samsung tab, buttons enable only when platform === 'Samsung'. Confirmed working. ✓

ACTION_LOG_TEMPLATES now includes samsung_detect / samsung_read_pit / samsung_factory_reset. All three stream expected log lines. samsung-frp reuses existing `bypass_frp` template (line 169 of ActionGrid.jsx sets key='bypass_frp' for the Samsung FRP button) — reasonable. ✓
AppContext.startSearch coerces non-string arg to 'auto' (line 63) — protects against onClick event object being passed accidentally. ✓
BRIDGE_METHODS includes samsung.* entries (lines 17-19) so live-mode path is wired; PATH B (demo) correctly used when bridge status !== 'connected'. ✓
Weighted pool pick in pickPool: 40% MTK / 35% QC / 25% Samsung — reasonable mix for auto scans (comment says '~1 in 4 auto scans'). ✓
Known-good chip cloud correctly highlights 'Galaxy S9' when connected Samsung model contains that substring — verified in screenshot (green border). ✓
